name: copilot-agent-mesh-codespaces
description: Workspace-side execution companion for desktop Copilot Agent Mesh.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Mesh execution requires a trusted Codespace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Mesh execution requires the Codespace filesystem.

chatSessions.name: mesh-codespaces
chatSessions.description: Real Mesh-owned Codespace tasks and retained history. Start and continue tasks with the source Mesh tools.

chatParticipants.name: meshCodespaces
chatParticipants.description: Native display for authorized Mesh tasks, not a separate model invocation.

copilotAgentMesh.codespaces.nativeChat.e.markdownDescription: POC: show authorized Codespace tasks in native Chat and Sessions. On first activation, Mesh automatically saves this companion's desktop API permission; fully restart VS Code once, without command-line parameters. An explicit false disables automatic setup. Does not change task authorization or start a second Agent.

copilotAgentMesh.codespaces.nativeChat.a.markdownDescription: Open the target window's native Chat editor when an authorized Mesh task starts. Turning this off keeps the session in Sessions without taking focus.

copilotAgentMesh.codespaces.codePath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to a native Linux VS Code CLI inside this Codespace. Leave empty to use the explicitly installed Mesh runtime. The remote terminal's `code` wrapper is not supported.
